modules.title: Introduction to Sequences and Series (Advanced)
modules.html:
Arithmetic and geometric progressions, and sums to infinity. This section covers introduction to sequences and series (advanced).

Key points

  • The sum to infinity of a geometric series is 12 and the first term is 4. Find the common ratio. — $$2/3$$.
  • Find the sum to infinity of the series $$1 + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{27} + \dots$$. — $$\frac{3}{2}$$.

Worked examples

Q: The sum to infinity of a geometric series is 12 and the first term is 4. Find the common ratio.
A: $$2/3$$ — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: $$2/3$$.

Q: Find the sum to infinity of the series $$1 + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{27} + \dots$$.
A: $$\frac{3}{2}$$ — Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: $$\frac{3}{2}$$.

Find the sum to infinity of the series $$1 + \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{9} + \frac{1}{27} + \dots$$.
